statement: The recorded recipient is the handling reviewer (t.okonkwo@riverbend.edu), but the letter text names the authors and their institution, which would break the double-blind protocol by revealing author identities to the reviewer. The decision letter must go to the corresponding author instead.
judge_text:
WRONG
It states the recipient "would break the double-blind protocol by revealing author identities to the reviewer" and gives the correct recipient (the corresponding author).
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
